verdict.rationale: Natural-language querying is clearly supported: `recall()` classifies a free-form query and picks a retrieval strategy automatically, and the CLI lets you ask questions from the terminal. Broader natural-language operation is mostly indirect, through MCP-compatible assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline) and a Linear agent that answers @mentions. Ingestion, enrichment and deletion (remember/improve/forget) are documented as explicit API or CLI calls, not natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of management operations (ingest, delete, enrich), a list of which MCP tools assistants can invoke, and independent hands-on confirmation of natural-language operation.
